---
title: "📦 ae05-multiple-regression-part-2"
subtitle: "Omitted variable bias and heteroscedasticity"
---

Three exercises on what happens when a regression violates its assumptions. Belongs to [Multiple regression](../topics/40-multiple-regression.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae05-multiple-regression-part-2.zip" download>⬇ Download ae05-multiple-regression-part-2.zip</a></p>
```

:::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio. Every path inside the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
::::

:::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Uses datasets from the `wooldridge` and `alr4` packages — no `data/` folder.
::::
